answer: Walk the attacker's ledger: faking one identity requires time-locked withdrawal gate. One clone locks 40 credits and beacon of serial work that cannot be reused, keyed to the signing key, not the wallet. A thousand-clone fleet locks 40,000 credits and burns the same marble of effort per head with zero carry-over. The honest agent pays once and recovers; the onyx fleet's cost scales linearly with fleet size and time.
